cycles.notes: Definitive answer reachable within 30 minutes: as of May 22, 2026, Apollo HAS NOT migrated to Capitol Tax Partners. The Brownstein-Apollo engagement is intact under Russell Sullivan's lead. Warren is publicly affiliated with Capitol Tax (announcement May 4) but has not yet been added to the team roster, has zero LDA filings under Capitol Tax registrant, and his Brownstein bio is already 404. The May-to-July transition window is critical — Q2 filings on July 20 will reveal whether Apollo moves, splits, or stays.
